collection.name: Game Servers
collection.description: Multiplayer dedicated game servers powered by SteamCMD and native game engines
collection.author: Midnight Team

shard.name: Palworld
shard.description: Palworld dedicated multiplayer server for monster-catching, crafting, base-building, and exploration.
shard.author: Pocketpair & Midnight Team
shard.installScript:
#!/bin/bash
# Palworld Dedicated Server Installation Script for Midnight Panel
set -e
apt update && apt install -y curl lib32gcc-s1 ca-certificates

cd /tmp
mkdir -p /tmp/steamcmd
cd /tmp/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz "https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz"
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz

echo "Installing Palworld Dedicated Server (App ID 2394010)..."
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update 2394010 validate +quit

cd /mnt/server
chmod +x PalServer.sh
mkdir -p Pal/Saved/Config/LinuxServer
echo "Palworld installation complete!"
